_comment: Single source of truth for a typeset book. Edit this, then re-run the build. `settings` maps 1:1 onto DEFAULT_SETTINGS in reflow.js.

preview._comment: Which chapters the preview images cover. Spine indices: front matter is roughly 0-13, chapter 1 starts near 14. Keep this small — it is the fast feedback loop.

settings._marginComment: Gutter is wider than the outside edge to leave room for the fold and stitch. The difference is deliberately small — the spread reads as one field of text, and an over-wide gutter looks like a mistake. Gutter + outside is held constant, so narrowing the difference does not change the measure or the page count.
settings.fontFamily: Garamond, Baskerville, 'Palatino Linotype', Palatino, Georgia, serif
settings._sizeComment: Page count scales as roughly fontSize^2 x lineHeight. 11pt/1.42 gave 1161 pages; this lands under 900. The extra leading offsets the smaller size — a long measure needs it.
